author: Davidgo5867

english.text: On the 31st of March of 2022, morning, for a change from my pizzeria habit, I went straight to the cafe, where I drank iced black tea and ate barbecue potato chips. I saw Lizbeth, the Mexican ex-barista, and I asked her how her dance classes were going. She taught Dance Feet and Zumba, founded in Colombia. At the sandwich shop, I ate a tuna sandwich with black olives and drank black coffee. There were two muscular brown labourers ordering. In the afternoon, I ate two pizza pieces with a diet cola at the pizzeria. There were many multiracial customers, like an anthropological rainbow.

jyutping: hai2 2022 nin4 3 jyut6 31 hou6 ge3 ziu1 zou2，wai6 zo2 goi2 bin3 ngo5 hai2 pei1 saat3 dim3 ge3 zaap6 gwaan3，ngo5 zik6 zip3 heoi3 zo2 gaan1 gaa3 fe1 gun2，hai2 go2 dou6 ngo5 jam2 zo2 bing1 hung4 caa4 tung4 sik6 zo2 go3 siu1 haau1 syu4 pin2，ngo5 man6 keoi5 keoi5 gaau3 ge3 mou5 dou6 baan1 hai6 dim2 joeng2 zeon3 hang4。hai2 saam1 man4 zi6 dim3，ngo5 sik6 zo2 go3 tan1 naa4 jyu2 saam1 man4 zi6 pui3 hak1 gaam3 laam2，jam2 zo2 hak1 gaa3 fe1。haa6 zau3，ngo5 hai2 bok6 beng2 pou1 sik6 zo2 loeng5 go3 bok6 beng2 tung4 jat1 bui1 zit3 sik6 ho2 lok6。
text: 喺2022年3月31號嘅朝早，為咗改變我喺披薩店嘅習慣，我直接去咗間咖啡館，喺嗰度我飲咗冰紅茶同食咗個燒烤薯片，我問佢佢教嘅舞蹈班係點樣進行。喺三文治店，我食咗個吞拿魚三文治配黑橄欖，飲咗黑咖啡。下晝，我喺薄餅鋪食咗兩個薄餅同一杯節食可樂。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: On the 26th of February of 2022, I tried to keep my day simple. Before dawn, at the corner convenience store, I drank a cold canned Thai tea drink and ate a pizza submarine sandwich. In the chilly, grey-sky morning, I headed to the cafe, whilst I practiced meditatively by scribbling Japanese Kana glyphs on my hand with a finger. I drank iced black tea at the cafe, whilst the typical early-morning clients were there, a Caucasian and an Oriental. A robust man in a black, red, and white jacket and dark-grey rugby pants entered to get coffee and exited, as he talked on his smartphone. Homebound, I took the long route across the vast green school field, seemingly an Animist-Buddhist experience of being on a different planet, the northern snowcapped bluish mountains being visible beyond.

jyutping: hai2 2022 nin4 2 jyut6 26 hou6，ngo5 soeng4 si3 zoeng1 ngo5 ge3 jat1 jat6 bin3 dak1 gaan2 daan1。hai2 lai4 ming4 zi1 cin4，hai2 gaai1 gok3 ge3 si6 do1，ngo5 jam2 zo2 jat1 bui1 dung3 gun3 zong1 taai3 sik1 caa4 jam2 ban2，tung4 maai4 sik6 zo2 go3 bok6 beng2 cim4 teng5 saam1 man4 zi6。hai2 dung3 dung3 ge3 fui1 sik1 tin1 hung1 ge3 ziu1 zou2，ngo5 hoeng3 gaa3 fe1 gun2 fong1 hoeng3 haang4，tung4 si4 ngo5 hai2 ngo5 sau2 soeng6 jung6 sau2 zi2 hai2 gaa3 fe1 teng1 soeng6 min6 se2 zyu6 hak1 caa4 zi6 jing4 ge3 si4 hau6，ming5 soeng2 gam2 lin6 zaap6 hai2 go2 dou6，jat1 go3 baak6 jan4 tung4 jat1 go3 dung1 fong1 jan4。jat1 go3 zoek3 zyu6 hak1 sik1、hung4 sik1 tung4 baak6 sik1 ngoi6 tou3 tung4 sam1 fui1 sik1 laam5 fu3 ge3 gin6 zong3 naam4 jan2 jap6 zo2 heoi3 lo2 gaa3 fe1，jin4 hau6 lei4 hoi1 zo2，dong1 keoi5 hai2 keoi5 bou6 zi3 nang4 sau2 gei1 dou6 gong2 gan2 je5 ge3 si4 hau6，ngo5 zau6 haang4 zo2 jat1 tiu4 coeng4 ge3 lou6 sin3，cyun1 gwo3 gwong2 fut3 ge3 luk6 sik1 hok6 haau6 coeng4 dei6，ci5 fu4 hai6 jat1 go3 hai2 m4 tung4 sing1 kau4 ge3 dung6 mat6 zyu2 ji6 - fat6 gaau3 tai2 jim6，bak1 fong1 ge3 syut3 saan1 laam4 sik1 saan1 mak6 ho2 ji5 hai2 go2 bin1 gin3 dou2。
text: 喺2022年2月26號，我嘗試將我嘅一日變得簡單。喺黎明之前，喺街角嘅士多，我飲咗一杯凍罐裝泰式茶飲品，同埋食咗個薄餅潛艇三文治。喺凍凍嘅灰色天空嘅朝早，我向咖啡館方向行，同時我喺我手上用手指喺咖啡廳上面寫住黑茶字形嘅時候，冥想噉練習喺嗰度，一個白人同一個東方人。一個着住黑色、紅色同白色外套同深灰色欖褲嘅健壯男人入咗去攞咖啡，然後離開咗，當佢喺佢部智能手機度講緊嘢嘅時候，我就行咗一條長嘅路線，穿過廣闊嘅綠色學校場地，似乎係一個喺唔同星球嘅動物主義 - 佛教體驗，北方嘅雪山藍色山脈可以喺嗰邊見到。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: This is the future that we’re building, one where all of us here at home and around the world are free to live out our dreams. Where our children’s aspirations aren’t segregated into pink and blue. Where working families don’t have to choose between taking care of a loved one and earning a paycheck. Where women and girls, no matter where they live, are free from fear of violence -- including gun violence.

jyutping: nei1 go3 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gin3 laap6 gan2 ge3 mei6 loi4，ngo5 dei6 so2 jau5 jan4 hai2 uk1 kei2 tung4 sai3 gaai3 gok3 dei6 dou1 ho2 ji5 zi6 jau4 gam2 sat6 jin6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 mung6 soeng2。ngo5 dei6 di1 siu2 pang4 jau5 ge3 zi3 hoeng3 m4 hai6 fan1 sing4 fan2 hung4 sik1 tung4 laam4 sik1。hai2 nei1 dou6，daa2 gung1 zai2 gaa1 ting4 m4 sai2 hai2 ziu3 gu3 oi3 jan4 tung4 zaan6 jan4 gung1 zi1 gaan1 gaan2。nei1 dou6 ge3 neoi5 sing3 tung4 neoi5 tung4，mou4 leon6 keoi5 dei6 zyu6 hai2 bin1，dou1 m4 wui6 hung2 geoi6 bou6 lik6 —— baau1 kut3 coeng1 haai6 bou6 lik6。
text: 呢個係我哋建立緊嘅未來，我哋所有人喺屋企同世界各地都可以自由噉實現我哋嘅夢想。我哋啲小朋友嘅志向唔係分成粉紅色同藍色。喺呢度，打工仔家庭唔使喺照顧愛人同賺人工之間揀。呢度嘅女性同女童，無論佢哋住喺邊，都唔會恐懼暴力 —— 包括槍械暴力。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: The liberals of the nineteen-thirties were diverse, but they had a common vision. They accepted democracy, the free market, and capitalism. However, they thought that unless the market was not corrected or ameliorated, there would be child labor, neglect of the elderly, dangerous and harmful consumer goods, monopolies squeezing people out of business and forcing down wages — in short, there would be the horror of Great Britain's Industrial Revolution before the British began passing social legislation.

jyutping: 1930 nin4 doi6 ge3 zi6 jau4 paai3 hai6 do1 jyun4 faa3 ge3，daan6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 jau5 jat1 go3 gung6 tung4 ge3 jyun6 ging2，daan6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 zip3 sau6 man4 zyu2、zi6 jau4 si5 coeng4 tung4 zi1 bun2 zyu2 ji6，daan6 hai6，keoi5 dei6 jing6 wai4 ceoi4 fei1 si5 coeng4 m4 bei6 gau2 zing3 waak6 ze2 goi2 sin6，fau2 zak1 zau6 wui5 ceot1 jin6 tung4 gung1、fat1 si6 lou5 jan4 gaa1、ngai4 him2 tung4 jau5 hoi6 ge3 siu1 fai3 ban2、lung5 dyun6，zoeng1 jan4 dei6 zai1 ceot1 lai4 zou6 saang1 ji3，tung4 maai4 bik1 si2 gung1 zi1 haa6 gong3 — zung2 zi1，hai2 daai6 jing1 dai3 gwok3 hoi1 ci2 gung1 jip6 gaak3 ming6 zi1 cin4，zau6 wui5 ceot1 jin6 hung2 bou3 ge3 se5 wui2 laap6 faat3。
text: 1930 年代嘅自由派係多元化嘅，但係佢哋有一個共同嘅願景，但係佢哋接受民主、自由市場同資本主義，但係，佢哋認為除非市場唔被糾正或者改善，否則就會出現童工、忽視老人家、危險同有害嘅消費品、壟斷，將人哋擠出嚟做生意，同埋迫使工資下降 — 總之，喺大英帝國開始工業革命之前，就會出現恐怖嘅社會立法。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: This 7th of May of 2025 started with grey clouds in the morning but became a summery sunny day later on. On my 5th walk this spring to the Roman Catholic church on St. Albans Road, I saw my Fijian neighbour Moli weeding her lawn, whilst she was not trimming her shrubs shaped like small fat phalluses. As she liked "controlling plants," I suggested to her about the art of bonsai. (Her name means "orange" in Fijian. Moli is a Chinese and East Indian hybrid.) I went on to the church. Today's Wednesday, so the main worship hall and the smaller Adoration Chapel are almost empty. Besides that church, I like visiting the Buddhist temple on Steveston Highway. Today, in a long walk, I trudged towards the Mormon temple on Williams Road. I saw some small parks with tall trees. I peeked inside the Mormon temple for the very first time. Elder On introduced me. He is a Cantonese that speaks also Mandarin. He is one of a team of missionaries that cater to Mandarin-speakers, here on Lulu Island. Later after walking more, I had Classic Lemonade at Tim Hortons café.

jyutping: ni1 go3 2025 nin4 5 jyut6 7 hou6 hai2 ziu1 zou2 hoi1 ci2 jau5 fui1 sik1 ge3 wan4，daan6 hai6 zi1 hau6 zau6 bin3 sing4 haa6 jat6 ge3 cing4 tin1。gam1 nin4 ceon1 tin1 ngo5 dai6 ng5 ci3 haang4 heoi3 sing3 aa3 ji5 bun2 si1 dou6 ge3 lo4 maa5 tin1 zyu2 gaau3 gaau3 tong2，ngo5 gin3 dou2 ngo5 ge3 fei2 zai3 leon4 geoi1 mok6 lei6 hai2 keoi5 ge3 cou2 ping4 soeng6 min6 ceoi4 cou2，ji4 keoi5 mou5 sau1 zin2 gan2 keoi5 di1 hou2 ci5 fei4 tung4 sai3 di1 jam1 ging3 gam2 ge3 gun3 muk6，jan1 wai6 keoi5 zung1 ji3「hung3 zai3 zik6 mat6」，so2 ji5 ngo5 hoeng3 keoi5 tai4 ceot1 zo2 pun4 ging2 ge3 ngai6 seot6（keoi5 go3 meng2 ge3 ji3 si1 fei2 zai3 ge3「caang2 sik1」hai6 zung1 gwok3 tung4 dung1 jan3 dou6 ge3 wan6 hyut3 ji4。）ngo5 gai3 zuk6 heoi3 gaau3 tong2。gam1 jat6 hai6 sing1 kei4 saam1，so2 ji5 zyu2 jiu3 ge3 sung4 baai3 tong4 tung4 gaau3 sai3 ge3 sung4 baai3 gaau3 tong2 gei1 fu4 dou1 hai6 hung1 ge3。ceoi4 zo2 go2 gaan1 gaau3 tong2 zi1 ngoi6，ngo5 zung6 zung1 ji3 heoi3 si2 tai4 fu1 si1 deon6 gung1 lou6 ge3 fat6 zi2。gam1 jat6，hai2 jat1 dyun6 coeng4 ge3 bou6 hang4 jap6 min6，ngo5 hoeng3 wai1 lim4 si1 dou6 ge3 mo1 mun4 gaau3 zi6 miu2 fong1 hoeng3 haang4。ngo5 gin3 dou2 jau5 di1 siu2 gung1 jyun2，jau5 di1 gou1 syu6。ngo5 dai6 jat1 ci3 tau1 kwai1 mo1 mun4 gaau3 sing3 din6 jap6 min6。on1 zoeng2 lou5 gaai3 siu6 zo2 ngo5。keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 sik1 gong2 waa4 jyu5 ge3 hoeng1 gong2 jan4。keoi5 hai6 jat1 baan1 wai6 pou2 tung1 waa2 jan4 si6 tai4 gung1 fuk6 mou6 ge3 cyun4 gaau3 si6 tyun4 deoi2 zi1 jat1，hai2 nei1 dou6 lou6 lou6 dou2。hau6 loi4 haang4 do1 di1 zi1 hau6，ngo5 hai2 Tim Hortons gaa3 fe1 teng1 jam2 zo2 ging1 din2 ning4 mung1 seoi2。
text: 呢個2025年5月7號喺朝早開始有灰色嘅雲，但係之後就變成夏日嘅晴天。今年春天我第五次行去聖阿爾本斯道嘅羅馬天主教教堂，我見到我嘅斐濟鄰居莫利喺佢嘅草坪上面除草，而佢冇修剪緊佢啲好似肥同細啲陰莖噉嘅灌木，因為佢鍾意「控制植物」，所以我向佢提出咗盆景嘅藝術（佢個名嘅意思斐濟嘅「橙色」係中國同東印度嘅混血兒。）我繼續去教堂。今日係星期三，所以主要嘅崇拜堂同較細嘅崇拜教堂幾乎都係空嘅。除咗嗰間教堂之外，我仲鍾意去史提夫斯頓公路嘅佛寺。今日，喺一段長嘅步行入面，我向威廉斯道嘅摩門教寺廟方向行。我見到有啲小公園，有啲高樹。我第一次偷窺摩門教聖殿入面。安長老介紹咗我。佢係一個識講華語嘅香港人。佢係一班為普通話人士提供服務嘅傳教士團隊之一，喺呢度露露島。後來行多啲之後，我喺 Tim Hortons 咖啡廳飲咗經典檸檬水。
